source_attempt.preservation: read-only extraction from frozen retained evidence

extraction_scope.launch_filter: event category equals cuda_runtime and event name equals cudaGraphLaunch
extraction_scope.launch_to_kernel_pairing: exact equality of args.correlation within one Chrome trace
extraction_scope.invocation_membership: event start timestamp is inside the CPU user_annotation named nested_graphs_compiled_invocation
extraction_scope.graph_replay_event_shape: Each graph_replays entry is one cuda_runtime cudaGraphLaunch callback plus the kernel event with the same args.correlation. Kernel name_key resolves through kernel_name_dictionary.
extraction_scope.other_kernel_event_shape: Each other_kernel_activity entry is one cuda_runtime cudaLaunchKernel callback plus the kernel event with the same args.correlation. Kernel name_key resolves through kernel_name_dictionary.

graph_identity_and_topology.interpretation: The retained traces identify replay-associated kernel nodes through correlation plus kernel graph and node IDs. They do not retain a CUDA Graph definition or node dependency edges, so they cannot reconstruct full graph topology.

qualification_boundary.qualification_review_verdict_scope: actual environment, source/runtime/PID binding, mechanism, and Chrome-profile capture gates only
qualification_boundary.statement: Trace event timing is descriptive profile evidence. It is not acceptance performance and does not establish a qualified performance win.

scope_limitations: Only the two frozen seed-0 nested_break_depth8 Chrome traces were extracted.
No workload rerun, remote access, GPU action, torch import, or source edit was performed.
Correlation IDs, graph IDs, and graph node IDs are interpreted only within their source trace.
The trace has no explicit CUDA Graph definition or dependency-edge list.
Kernel events whose graph id and graph node id are zero are retained as other kernel activity and are not presented as CUDA Graph replay nodes.
Profile event durations are not substituted for the predeclared acceptance metrics.
